About this archive

Built alongside the Google Doc "Occult Research (2026)", which holds the long-form text. Dates for undated ancient texts follow mainstream scholarship and are approximate. Where scholars disagree, the entry says so.

Illustrations are public-domain engravings: Gustave Doré's Bible illustrations (1866, unless noted) and Albrecht Dürer's Apocalypse woodcuts (1498), as collected on Wikimedia Commons. They are artistic interpretations from the 15th and 19th centuries, not ancient images.
